name: Basalt Columns
reason: For: two counted sources (Wikivoyage, tourism board), one of the best-known sights. Against: the gate needs a key from Hotel Chathams, so access is not freely open.

name: Hapupu National Historic Reserve
reason: For: DOC, Wikivoyage and tourism board all name it; the last concentration of Moriori tree carvings, a national historic reserve. Against: access is restricted to local whanau and DOC-approved guided tours, so not open to the public on arrival. Existing spot that now only reaches review.

name: Nunuku's Cave
reason: For: Wikivoyage names the cave with ancient carvings and the Nunuku story. Against: one counted source and access arrangements are not stated.

name: Pitt Island
reason: Inhabited island with farmland, cliffs, rare birds and day trips; Wikivoyage and tourism board name it; a destination-level place judged on merit.

name: Point Munning Seal Colony
reason: Two counted sources; fur seal colony reached by a short bush walk through a farm; a real wildlife visit.

name: Te Whanga Lagoon
reason: Large lagoon covering a fifth of the island, named by Wikivoyage and DOC; fishing, wetland walks.

name: Admiral Gardens
reason: Two counted sources; garden with sculptures and a reserve walk through dunes to Long Beach, bookable.

name: Long Beach
reason: For: white sand beach reached on foot from Admiral Gardens. Against: one counted source, named only as the end of that walk.

name: Awatotara Bush Coastal Walk
reason: Two counted sources; 2.5-3 hour coastal bush track with creek crossings and native birds.

name: Tuku Nature Reserve
reason: For: Wikivoyage names the Tuku Valley walks. Against: one source naming the area only through a tour, overlaps Awatotara walk.

name: Tommy Solomon Statue
reason: For: two counted sources, a roadside icon of the last full-blooded Moriori. Against: a minor memorial statue, a short roadside stop.

name: Kōpinga Marae
reason: Two counted sources; Moriori marae with contemporary carvings and a weekly guided tour (Wednesdays 10 am); worth an hour. Flag: tour-only timing.

name: German Mission House
reason: Two counted sources; 1866-68 stone cottage by Moravian missionaries with a caretaker tour; open by appointment.

name: Sunderland NZ4111 Flying Boat
reason: For: two counted sources, a rare 1945 flying boat fuselage. Against: in a shed on a private farm, viewing by arrangement only, under restoration.

name: Mission Bay Ruins
reason: For: Wikivoyage names the missionary and sealer ruins by the bay. Against: one source, a farm visit, ruins only; possibly same as Te Whakaru.

name: Te Whakaru
reason: Likely the same site as Mission Bay Ruins (near-duplicate); one source, approximate coordinates.

name: Port Hutt
reason: Two counted sources; Wikivoyage calls it one of the most attractive harbours in NZ; harbour with wreck remains.

name: Kaingaroa
reason: Two counted sources; fishing village with bay, sandy beaches, endemic plants and birds.

name: Whangaroa Seafoods Factory

name: Ocean Mail Scenic Reserve
reason: Three counted sources incl. DOC; 831 ha wetland reserve with walks, picnic beach and dunes.

name: Nikau Bush Conservation Area
reason: DOC and Wikivoyage; two hour-long loop walks through nikau forest.

name: Tikitiki Hill
reason: For: DOC and Wikivoyage name the lookout over Waitangi. Against: only a 10 minute return walk, short of half an hour.

name: Norman Kirk Memorial Reserve
